headline.zh: 为建筑项目生成结构精确的设计方案
headline.en: Generate structurally precise designs for building projects

scenario.zh: 提供项目需求，获得符合建筑标准的完整设计方案
scenario.en: Provide project requirements, receive complete designs meeting building codes

instruction.zh: 选择项目类型并提供基本参数
instruction.en: Select project type and provide basic parameters

output.zh: 生成包含结构布局和承重系统的设计
output.en: Generate design with structural layout and load-bearing system

input.zh: 德州奥斯汀，3层住宅楼，24个单元，每层8单元，总面积18000平方英尺，钢筋混凝土框架
input.en: Austin TX, 3-story residential building, 24 units, 8 per floor, 18,000 sq ft total, reinforced concrete frame

output.zh: 中央承重核心墙系统，外围柱网间距20英尺，楼板厚度8英寸，考虑德州抗风荷载要求，预留机电竖井空间
output.en: Central load-bearing core wall system, perimeter column grid at 20-foot spacing, 8-inch floor slab thickness, accounts for Texas wind load requirements, reserved MEP shaft space

output.zh: 生成开放式平面和结构框架方案
output.en: Generate open floor plan with structural framework

input.zh: 加州圣何塞，单层零售店，5000平方英尺，大开间无内墙，钢结构框架，抗震设防
input.en: San Jose CA, single-story retail, 5,000 sq ft, large open space without interior walls, steel frame, seismic design

output.zh: 钢柱网格30英尺跨度，轻质屋面系统，加州地震区特殊抗弯框架，基础考虑土壤液化风险，外墙预留橱窗开口
output.en: Steel column grid with 30-foot spans, lightweight roof system, special moment frame for California seismic zone, foundation accounts for soil liquefaction risk, perimeter walls with storefront openings

instruction.zh: 选择需要优化的设计方面

output.zh: 调整柱网和材料以提高效率
output.en: Adjust column grid and materials for efficiency

output.zh: 增加竖井和管道预留位置
output.en: Add shaft and conduit reserved locations

output.zh: 优化梁柱尺寸同时保持抗震性能
output.en: Optimize beam and column sizes while maintaining seismic performance

output.zh: 在屋面框架中集成天窗开口
output.en: Integrate skylight openings in roof framework

takeaway.zh: 此演示展示了如何为虚构项目生成结构设计概念，实际平台能力需在Dream官网验证，真实项目需在其平台完成
takeaway.en: This demo shows structural design concepts for fictional projects; actual platform capabilities require verification on Dream's site, real projects must be completed on their platform
